Scanned the entire repository: 3 tracked files (index.html, about.html, styles.css), one commit, two ship branches both identical to main, and the full working tree including hidden files. No build system, no CI, no JS, no images, no gallery markup anywhere. Since the task is plan-only, the findings below are the verified constraints any future gallery implementation must respect, not defects I fixed. Key verified facts: the home page hero is index.html lines 15-17 (h1, .tagline, one driftwood paragraph) inside a
that closes on line 18 — that is the natural slot for three photo cards; styles.css (20 lines total) contains only body/nav/footer/.tagline rules with no flex or grid anywhere; and the repo contains zero image files and zero /src= attributes, so the "photos" for the cards do not exist yet and must be sourced before implementation. Everything below was confirmed by direct reading with line numbers.
